name: delivery-docket
title: Delivery docket
for_each: select id,docket_no from dockets order by docket_no

sections.title: Concrete supplied
sections.note: Check the fields your customers and your standard require on a docket before printing it as your delivery record.
sections.sql: select mix,grade_mpa strength_grade_mpa,slump_mm specified_slump_mm,max_aggregate_mm,(select admixtures from mixes m join orders o on o.mix_id=m.id join dockets d on d.order_id=o.id where d.id=$1) admixtures from v_dockets where docket_id=$1

name: test-certificate
title: Concrete test results
for_each: select id,code from samples order by code

sections.title: Compressive strength
sections.note: Results as recorded from the laboratory report. The laboratory report is the original record.
sections.sql: select age_days,tested_on,mpa,lab_ref from results where sample_id=$1 order by age_days

name: pour-confirmation
title: Pour confirmation
for_each: select id,code from orders where status in ('booked','confirmed') order by code

sections.title: Your pour
sections.sql: select o.code order_no,c.name customer,s.name site,s.address,o.pour_date,to_char(o.start_time,'HH24:MI') first_load,o.element,m.code mix,m.description,o.volume_m3,o.pump,o.po_ref your_reference from orders o join customers c on c.id=o.customer_id join sites s on s.id=o.site_id join mixes m on m.id=o.mix_id where o.id=$1

name: customer-statement
title: Loads delivered
for_each: select id,code from customers order by code

sections.title: Customer
sections.sql: select code,name,email,phone from customers where id=$1

sections.title: Loads in the last 90 days
sections.sql: select d.docket_no,d.day,d.site,d.mix,d.volume_m3,d.returned_m3,d.invoice_ref from v_dockets d join customers c on c.name=d.customer where c.id=$1 and d.day>=current_date-90 order by d.day,d.docket_no
